ABOUT AMPLIQ

A growth partner bringing marketing, HR and management together under one roof

AMPLIQ is a Saudi group headquartered in Riyadh, specializing in digital marketing, human resources management and management consulting.

We work as an extension of our clients’ teams across government entities, educational institutions and private companies. We start by understanding where you are today, then build the strategy, deliver it and measure its impact — turning goals into tangible results.

We believe an organization doesn’t have to build every function in-house from day one. That’s why we provide a complete team of experts — at a flexible cost, with measurable results.

  • Digital Marketing

    We create demand and drive growth

  • Human Resources

    We build teams and organize the workplace

  • Management Consulting

    We diagnose, plan and execute

VISION, MISSION & NAME

Our vision & mission

Our vision

To be the smartest growth partner for organizations in Saudi Arabia, through marketing and management solutions that create measurable impact and support Vision 2030’s goals of empowering the private sector and raising institutional efficiency.

Our mission

We deliver integrated marketing, human resources and management consulting services that combine hands-on expertise, data and technology — raising our clients’ efficiency, accelerating their growth, and relieving them of the burden of building every function in-house.

The meaning of our name

AMPLIQ = Amplify + IQ

Amplify
We amplify impact, extend reach and elevate presence.
IQ
We ground every decision in intelligence, analysis and data.

Our values

CHALLENGES WE SOLVE

Challenges we solve

We start from the client’s real problem — not from an off-the-shelf list of services.

Marketing without clear impact

Ad spend and campaigns that aren’t tied to KPIs or to sales results.

Strategy that stays on paper

Good plans that stall in execution for lack of follow-up and clear ownership.

Fragmented vendors

Separate providers for marketing, hiring and consulting, with no unified vision.

Hard-to-reach talent

Slow, costly hiring, and teams whose skills don’t match what the stage requires.

Lack of structure

Relying on improvisation instead of clear structures, policies and procedures.

Growth that outpaces readiness

Expansion strains the team and operations before they’re ready.

01DIGITAL MARKETING

Digital marketing

From visibility to growth: we plan, execute and measure — and tie every advertising riyal to a result.

Marketing strategy

Market, audience and competitor analysis, and annual and quarterly marketing plans tied to business goals.

Brand management

Clear positioning, marketing messages and a consistent identity across every customer touchpoint.

Paid advertising campaigns

Planning and managing campaigns across social media and search engines, optimized daily to lower costs.

Content & platform management

Monthly content plans, creative copywriting, design and visual production, and account and community management.

Seasonal campaigns & launches

Ramadan, Saudi National Day, seasonal peaks, and launches of new products and services.

Performance measurement & reporting

Dashboards and regular reports that link spend to results, with clear recommendations for improvement.

01DIGITAL MARKETING

What do you get?

Clear deliverables, and KPIs we track and report on regularly.

Deliverables

  • An approved marketing plan with clear goals and budget

02HUMAN RESOURCES

Human resources management

A specialized practice that helps organizations build strong teams, organize the workplace and stay compliant — from setup to development.

Organizational structures

Designing the structure, departments and lines of authority to suit the organization’s size.

Job descriptions

A card for every role that defines its tasks, qualifications and KPIs.

Talent acquisition & recruitment

Defining needs, advertising, screening and interviewing — all the way to hiring.

Policies & regulations

Work regulations and internal policies in line with the Saudi Labor Law.

Performance management

Individual KPIs, appraisal cycles and clear improvement plans.

Salary scales & benefits

Structuring pay, allowances and incentives fairly and competitively.

Training & development

Training needs analysis and employee development plans.

Saudization & compliance

Supporting Saudization requirements and compliance with the relevant regulations.

HOW WE WORK

How we work

Five clear stages that make sure every step builds on the one before it.

  1. 01

    Analyze

    We understand your goal, current situation and audience, and pinpoint the gap between where you are and where you want to be.

  2. 02

    Design

    We define the scope, plan, budget and KPIs, and agree on them with you.

  3. 03

    Execute

    We run the service as an extension of your team, with clear responsibilities and timelines.

  4. 04

    Measure

    We track KPIs and deliver regular reports that show the real impact.

  5. 05

    Optimize

    We continuously improve performance based on results and data.

ENGAGEMENT MODELS

Engagement models

Flexible models that fit your organization’s size, stage and budget.

Monthly retainer

A complete team working as an extension of yours, with a fixed monthly scope and deliverables.

Best for: Organizations that need ongoing marketing and operations.

Defined project

A clear scope, timeline and deliverables, handed over in full.

Best for: Restructuring, drafting regulations and launching brands.

Marketing campaign

Planning and running a campaign with a specific goal and a known budget.

Best for: Seasons, launches and special offers.

Tailored consultation

Sessions, workshops and diagnostic reports to tackle a specific challenge.

Best for: Strategic decisions and rapid assessments.
